title: Bug 648577: [IT] Subcontracting migration does not precheck bin-mandatory locations
summary: Subcontracting migration now checks bin-mandatory locations for incompatible warehouse settings before processing, blocking the migration if unsupported configurations are found and reporting all violations.
key_points: Adds validation to prevent migration when legacy or purchase-header locations use unsupported warehouse settings
Reports every incompatible location with each enabled setting listed
Migration data remains untouched if precheck fails
Uses explicit error handling instead of relying on platform dialog concatenation
Includes test coverage for multiple locations and all unsupported warehouse configurations
quote: Block IT subcontracting migration when legacy vendor or purchase-header locations use unsupported warehouse settings.
